educationalGoal: You will work on problem solution for local society and familiar real world as team activity based on experience of "Design Project Introduction" and "Design Project I". Then you will develop team activity abilities and leadership. You will report and announce project activity with writing and oral. Then you will develop communication skills which convey your ideas to others accurately.
advice: In "Design Project I", you will propose a solution to discovered problem in the given main theme according to the activities shown below. The proposal will be verified in "Design Project Execute". ・Project theme selection...discovering problems Your team will select project theme based on discovered problems in the given main theme. The project theme will be selected according to your interest, experience, knowledge, etc. ・Market research and customer request analysis...problem clarification and setting Research and analyze the current state of the target. Discover problems and its solution based on the results. Decide project theme and research market products related to the project theme. ・Specification setting...determination of proposal specification and goal setting Show requirements before solution idea suggestion. The requirements should be set based on the collected information from the market research and the customer request analysis. ・Idea creation and improvement...idea creation that satisfy specifications and solve the problem Create various ideas to solve the problem. Improve the idea by checking the specifications. In addition, clarify contrivance and feasibility of the idea.

requiredKnowledge: Review following skills what you have learned in "Design Project Introduction" and "Design Project I": Information survey, Idea creation, Presentation, Team activity, Theoretical verification activity.

activityGoals.body: To be able to discover problems from main theme.
To be able to collect information for problem solving and combine it.
To be able to create multiple proposals (idea) which lead to the problem solution.
To be able to plan the validity verification of the proposal.
To be able to communicate about technical information using figures.
To be able to show posture of objective evaluation of own abilities.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. You can discuss and create multiple ideas to solve problem set in the project theme. 2. You can design the solution in detail. 3. You can make execution plan to make progress "Design Project Execute" and write it down in project execution planning document clearly. 4. You can summarize activity results in slide and poster, and can announce it clearly. You can also respond to questions and answer in an appropriate manner.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. You can discuss and create an idea to solve problem set in the project theme. 2. You can design the solution. 3. You can make execution plan to make progress "Design Project Execute" and write it down in project execution planning document. 4. You can summarize activity results in slide and poster, and can announce it clearly. *A demerit mark is given to lateness, unexcused absence, and negative team contribution from an individual point total.
